newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was quiet late Monday. There were not enough slaughter steers or heifers sold for a market test at the close.

Inquiry was moderate, demand was light. Sales confirmed on 200 slaughter heifers. For the week to date including late Friday and the weekend on 12,700 cattle including 10,500 head previously contracted or formulated cattle.
confirmed: 200 last week: none last year: 2600
